SDK convention/export identifiers in declaration and callback positions, with negative dynamic precedence preserving ordinary declarations; source-byte-preserving grammar extension via scripts/patch_cpp_macro_grammar.py.
Conditional initializer-list entries with nested preprocessor branch aliases and original source spans; ordinary list commas remain required; reproduce via scripts/patch_cpp_macro_grammar.py.

Unnamed pointer default parameters and class-scoped pointer fields; named member scope and negative precedence preserve existing declaration and global delete parses; reproduce via scripts/patch_cpp_macro_grammar.py.
Admit abstract member-function pointers only in explicit type descriptors, retaining global-delete parses.
Parameter SDK annotations with contextual identifiers and negative precedence; retain spans and exclude annotation arguments from runtime call references.
Conditional SDK if/else prefixes ending before #endif share a following statement; exact boundary and original spans preserved, ordinary dangling else remains invalid.
SDK pointer-return conventions require a directly named function declarator, avoiding recursive parameter-parenthesis ambiguity; reproduce with scripts/patch_cpp_macro_grammar.py.
Conditional linkage braces in complete optionally nested preprocessor guard groups; retain guard conditions, source spans and declarations without source preprocessing.
Multiple replacement-list fragments separated by block comments in object/function macro definitions; preserve original preproc_arg/comment spans with LF or CRLF continuations.
Accept decltype base-specifiers in class base lists without changing declaration calling-convention paths; retain original operand spans.
Scoped proof-backed statement-macro scanner and macro_statement audit node; default parsing keeps scanner context empty.
SDK calling conventions before inline member definitions, with existing declaration contexts unchanged; patch_cpp_macro_grammar.py, tree-sitter 0.25.10 ABI 14 and --finalize ASCII fast path.
Braced default parameter values retain initializer_list nodes without invented missing types; explicit default-value context only, ABI 14 and original spans preserved via patch_cpp_macro_grammar.py.

Annotation-free parameter path only for directly named pointer-return functions, preserving array-reference parameters without missing types. Existing SDK path stays parallel; aliases retain visible kinds. scripts/patch_cpp_macro_grammar.py, ABI 14.

Annotation-free explicit function declaration/definition alternative requires a named array-reference parameter; preserves reference declarators following pointer parameters without widening general declarators/expressions. scripts/patch_cpp_macro_grammar.py, ABI 14.

Native DLL function declarations require explicit __declspec and native calling convention in top-level/block contexts; retain existing declaration/function kinds and annotation metadata without general modifier widening. scripts/patch_cpp_macro_grammar.py, ABI 14.

Proof-backed invocation spacing accepts original block/line comments and all six C++ ASCII whitespace characters; scanner/audit rules match, splice/trigraph comments are declined, recovered product identity v2 invalidates older proofs. scripts/cpp_statement_macro_scanner.c.
Scoped static/extern declarations retain complete guarded storage modifiers and preprocessor conditions

Abstract member-data pointers only in explicit type_descriptor contexts with named scopes, existing declarator aliases and unchanged global abstract-pointer rules. scripts/patch_cpp_macro_grammar.py, ABI 14.

Complete unevaluated decltype operands admit comma_expression only inside decltype; preserve original spans, existing runtime-call exclusion and general expression rules. scripts/patch_cpp_macro_grammar.py, ABI 14.

Explicit MSVC brace-delimited mov/cpuid instructions with named destinations, decimal/identifier sources and line-bound operands; preserve original opcode/operand spans and genuine missing operands. scripts/patch_cpp_macro_grammar.py, ABI 14.
Explicit operator member access only through dot/arrow, preserving existing template methods and original operator call spans. scripts/patch_cpp_macro_grammar.py, ABI 14.

Split conditional if scopes require complete opening and closing guard groups with both branches, runtime conditions and complete else bodies; retain preprocessor/runtime spans and conservative macro-evidence boundaries. scripts/patch_cpp_macro_grammar.py, ABI 14.

Scoped Objective-C++ protocol/method declarations and plain object-string literals in explicit positive __OBJC__ guards; complete blocks retain following namespaces, selector metadata and variadic message arguments retain original spans. Keyword and nonplain string prefixes remain errors. Reproduce with scripts/patch_cpp_macro_grammar.py, ABI 14.
Scoped Objective-C selector metadata preserves original labels and spans without runtime callee nodes under exact positive guards; global C++ expressions remain unchanged.
Named dotted fields rooted in guarded Objective-C messages preserve ordinary field_expression aliases and original spans without broadening global C++ member/template rules.
Guarded Objective-C constructor member-initializer arguments retain field_initializer/list and argument_list aliases with original message/call spans; global C++ declarations remain unchanged.

Separate guarded Objective-C declaration/body contexts reject standalone dialect statements in files/namespaces and retain nested function-body preprocessor contexts; upstream C++ fragment rules are unchanged.

Exact #ifndef __OBJC__ guards retain an ordinary C++ first arm and a complete Objective-C else arm in separate declaration/body contexts; original preproc aliases and spans are retained without condition evaluation.
Proof-backed dangling-if macro scanner token and else_clause attachment, closed-statement framing preserved; original source spans and empty default context retained.

Explicit positive _MANAGED guard: handle parameter/return declarators, handle template static calls and struct specialization, existing container aliases and original spans; global C++ declarators and XOR unchanged.

Two complete #if/#else function heads share an explicit original trailing body in declaration scopes; preserve conditions and spans, expose header fragments and attribute body references to both alternatives without branch selection.

Unqualified explicit operator calls retain operator_name and argument_list with low static and negative dynamic precedence; keep ordinary declarators viable and do not promote operator names to general expressions.

Declaration-scoped inverse __OBJC__ guards admit primitive-return function definitions with mandatory function declarators and existing Objective-C compound-body aliases; reject general declaration specifiers and namespace bodies.
Permit an inline prefix on the original friend declaration with one explicit storage-class conflict; retain original function/declaration kinds and spans without keyword-as-type recovery.

Return-only conditional logical suffix groups retain the original left value, directive conditions and logical right operands, requiring complete directive lines and a final semicolon; no general expression expansion or branch selection.

Scoped exact invocation-site scanner context with a byte-offset capability supplied by the vendored runtime; TSLexer ABI and serialized scanner state are unchanged; standalone CLI requires no runtime symbol.
Scoped native function-prefix generator proof retains original body and argument spans without publishing generated named owners.

Scoped native complete function/declaration-list generator role: macro_declaration keeps original invocation and arguments, with no fabricated expanded names or bodies; scanner token is disabled without exact fresh proof.

Scoped native case/for-prefix generator role retains original invocation and authored body spans; native token agreement and direct switch context are required, with no fabricated expanded label or loop nodes.

Scoped native object-like inline specifier role consumes only the exact original identifier; independently matched single native token and fresh physical definition are required, with no global identifier modifier rule.

Scoped native try/catch-all/typed-handler prefixes require physical names and definitions plus independent native token origins; original handler bodies and authored parameters retain spans, while an object catch-all creates no fabricated parameters.
